## Применимость к проектам

Перенесены явные документальные оценки. Это частичный охват проектов, не проверенный integration seam и не измеренная польза.

- [dsh-runtime](../../projects/dsh-runtime.md): DEFERRED; DEFERRED / NEEDS_EVIDENCE. Tool orchestration and continuation reliability; transport lifecycle reference. Ограничения: No current target seam; security and failure gates unverified. Следующий тест: 30 synthetic tasks, exact exit codes/cancellation/integrity and p95. [Основание](../../reviews/gshell/2026-11-27.md); предыдущая оценка: нет.
- [agent-skills](../../projects/agent-skills.md): DEFERRED; DEFERRED / NEEDS_EVIDENCE. Reproducible verification and code-review profile; remote workspace recipe. Ограничения: No current skill contract; credentials and untrusted command risk. Следующий тест: 10 read-only fixture tasks and negative cases vs plain SSH. [Основание](../../reviews/gshell/2026-11-27.md); предыдущая оценка: нет.
- [HermesAgent](../../projects/HermesAgent.md): DEFERRED; DEFERRED / NEEDS_EVIDENCE. Robust sessions and tool access; lifecycle reference. Ограничения: No current source seam or persistent cloud runtime. Следующий тест: Compare existing SSH/tool access vs wrapper on bounded tasks. [Основание](../../reviews/gshell/2026-11-27.md); предыдущая оценка: нет.

## Эксперименты

- gshell-20261127-sftp-lab: ISOLATED_INTEGRATION / OBSERVED. Build, vet and smoke passed; 15 paired SFTP observations and separate Paper2Project arms passed 8/8 reproduction checks. Unchanged sync reads full file; changed download reads twice; network benefit criterion failed. Synthetic 1 MiB files, local SFTP protocol; not live cloud, not encrypted SSH wire or target project benefit.
